scope: T0 method only; no participants; no runtime or GUI automation change

procedure.name: change appearance on a disposable mock editor profile

baseline.competency_rule: at least 2 complete attempts, zero critical errors

retrieval_prompts.text: Without acting, state or select the next safe step; you may answer unsure.
Without acting, state or select the next safe step; you may answer unsure.
Without acting, state or select the next safe step; you may answer unsure.

exposure.task_resets: fresh disposable profile before each opportunity
exposure.automation_only: agent performs all six; complete visible action/evidence trace is retained
exposure.automation_retrieval: agent performs all six; complete visible action/evidence trace is retained
exposure.retrieval_prompt: Without acting, state or select the next safe step; you may answer unsure. The task goal and current state remain visible.
exposure.retrieval_prompt_timing: before agent action and before any correctness feedback
exposure.feedback: only after a response or explicit unsure; same action trace as automation-only
exposure.active_and_elapsed_time: record separately; neither is inferred from the other

constructs.delayed_retention: unaided ordered procedure plus final state after the 48-hour interval
constructs.transfer: unaided ordered procedure plus final state on the held-out status-bar variant
constructs.immediate_takeover: state reconstruction and next-safe-step judgment at explicit stop; separate instrument, not retained-procedure score
constructs.vigilance: unprompted hit/miss/false-alarm/correct-rejection counts for rare cues; separate signal-detection endpoint
constructs.scope_note: T0 validates separable rubric fields only; immediate takeover and vigilance are not pooled into the delayed-retention endpoint

scoring.ordered_steps: exact required action order; positional fraction also reported
scoring.critical: any action targets a non-disposable profile
scoring.major: wrong order, missing/extra action, or final state mismatch
scoring.missingness: retain randomized row as missing; no imputation in primary summaries; report by arm and provide worst/best bounds
scoring.analysis: intention-to-treat after randomization; do not use complete-case comparisons as causal estimates

exclusions_and_stops.pre_randomization: exclude only failure to meet baseline competency or inability to use the disposable mock with approved accessibility accommodations; retain screened counts/reasons
exclusions_and_stops.post_randomization: no outcome-based exclusions; retain all assigned records and missingness

sample_feasibility.contrasts: manual vs automation-only and automation-retrieval vs automation-only for core and transfer (four co-primary contrasts)
sample_feasibility.planning_approximation: two independent means, normal approximation, z_alpha/2 + z_power approximately 3.34; conservative no baseline-covariate credit
sample_feasibility.interpretation: assumption sensitivity only, not an observed effect or final power analysis
sample_feasibility.per_participant_burden_estimate: about 20 minutes for baseline/training and 10 minutes for the delayed core+transfer session; each retrieval prompt is capped at 15 seconds (45 seconds total)
sample_feasibility.feasibility_disposition: HOLD_T1: 318-648 recruited is substantial; refine the smallest meaningful effect, use exact ordinal-outcome power simulation, and confirm recruitment capacity/ethics before any participant work

T1_gate: independent protocol review, ethics/privacy approval, consent, recruitment plan, final preregistration, and separate explicit authorization; this T0 grants none
